title: Injectivity of the decrement exit map
statement: For every state type $S$ and designated state $a\in S$, the map from flag phases to counter-loop states that sends the successful completed phase to the body state at $a$, the unsuccessful completed phase to the finished state, and every other phase to the corresponding decrement phase is injective.
